detail.longDescription: My husband and I have very different relationships with starting things. He reads the entire manual before he touches anything. I open the box, press whatever looks most promising, and deal with the consequences later. We've been doing this dance for a dozen years, and obviously my approach works better. That's pretty much the Replit story. It's a browser-based coding platform that lets you skip the manual entirely: open a tab, describe your app, and the agent figures out the rest. It does front
